items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee addresses 'Gary' multiple times (e.g., 'We must have made it, Gary, in 25 minutes', 'You know who sounds like him? Paul Desmond... I'll tell you who sounds more like him, Gary'), indicating familiarity with the interviewer, but no specific professional or personal relationship histor

ctx.x: From Trent, Alfonso Trent's band. They had -- that was the one -- they had about 12, 14 uniforms. They used to be hanging up in my auntie's -- my other auntie's place and they were playing the Dolphus Hotel in Dallas, which was unknown. They was the only black band that played the Dolphus Hotel and they played there like a year and a half at a time and they were broadcasting from there. That really turned me on, you know, and they was sharp, man.

So anyway, we felt like if we was going to have a band, at least we'd look good. So we did. And she told him, she says, "Well, they look good." She says, "But I really haven't heard them play." He says, "Well, can you get them?" She says, "Oh, yeah." And she called us, I think it was about 25 miles. We must have made it, Gary, in 25 minutes, and when we got there, just like today, he had a line all the way around, just long, just people wanting to get in there to see him.
